description: Header file defining the VideoResourceUpdater class and related enums and classes for managing video frame resources in Chromium's media rendering pipeline.

classes.name: VideoFrameExternalResources
classes.description: Represents external resources associated with a video frame, including resource type, resources, release callbacks, and format parameters.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater
classes.description: Manages video frame resources for rendering, including importing, recycling, and appending video frames as draw quads in the compositor.

methods.name: ObtainFrameResources
methods.description: Imports resources for the next video frame for use in compositing.

methods.name: ReleaseFrameResources
methods.description: Releases resources after the frame has been submitted.

methods.name: AppendQuads
methods.description: Adds a draw quad for the specified video frame to the render pass.

methods.name: CreateExternalResourcesFromVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates external resource representations from a video frame.

methods.name: YuvSharedImageFormat
methods.description: Returns the shared image format for YUV video frames based on bits per channel.

methods.name: RecycleOrAllocateResource
methods.description: Recycles or allocates a resource for a video plane.

methods.name: AllocateResource
methods.description: Allocates a new resource for a video plane.

methods.name: CopyHardwarePlane
methods.description: Copies a hardware video plane into a new GL texture.

methods.name: CreateForHardwarePlanes
methods.description: Prepares resources for hardware-accelerated video planes.

methods.name: CreateForSoftwarePlanes
methods.description: Prepares resources for software-based video planes.

methods.name: ReturnTexture
methods.description: Returns a texture resource after use.
